command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'IDENTITY host=%s user=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
cd /home/andreas/self-integration
printf 'REPO_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'REPO_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'REPO_DIRTY_BEGIN\n'; git status --porcelain=v1; printf 'REPO_DIRTY_END\n'
printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)"
printf 'SERVICE_SUB=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p SubState --value)"
printf 'SERVICE_MAINPID=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)"
printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE_ENTER=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)"
printf 'SERVICE_DROPINS=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p DropInPaths --value)"
printf 'SERVICE_EXEC_CONDITION=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecCondition --value)"
printf 'SERVICE_EXEC_STOP_POST=%s\n' "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ExecStopPost --value)"
for f in werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf werkzeug/entityos-vm-semantic-cutover.conf; do printf 'SOURCE_SHA %s %s\n' "$f" "$(sha256sum "$f" | awk '{print $1}')"; done
for f in /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf; do if sudo -n test -e "$f"; then printf 'TARGET_SHA %s %s\n' "$f" "$(sudo -n sha256sum "$f" | awk '{print $1}')"; else printf 'TARGET_MISSING %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
printf 'CONFIG_ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR='; grep -E '^ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf || true
printf 'PREFLIGHT_READONLY_DONE=1\n'
